blocks.text:
After breakfast, take a sightseeing tour of Buenos Aires with an English-speaking guide, lasting around 3 hours.

At Plaza de Mayo, you will see the Casa Rosada, the Cathedral and government buildings. Your guide will explain the square’s history and its connection with Evita Perón.

The route continues through La Boca, San Telmo, Recoleta, the Obelisk area and modern Puerto Madero. The old quarters gradually give way to broad avenues and the glass buildings of the business districts.
